name: granola-mcp
description: Search, export, and analyze every Granola meeting across all your calls - attendee timelines, talk-time roll-ups, and transcript search from an offline local mirror.

granola_api_key.title: Granola API key
granola_api_key.description: Granola public API key (Personal or Workspace) from Granola Settings > API. Powers sync, meetings, transcripts, summaries, folders, attendees, talk-time, search, and MEMO.

granola_base_url.title: Granola API base URL
granola_base_url.description: The Granola public API root. Leave it at the default unless Granola support gives you a different host; a wrong value makes doctor report that base_url is not the Granola API.
